Copied from `runtime/composer/testdata/golden/` on ws/int-composer (composer 1.2.0, commit 2b54ee5): per-app networks (D-041), one read-only bind per declared secret file (D-042), and the host's `/run/sealed/secrets` bound into sealed-agent, which creates the owner directories itself. `golden12.test.ts` boots the agent on this exact app-compose.json with the tmpfs checks on, where only the secrets root is a tmpfs. Refresh these files whenever the composer's golden files change.
